key_findings: Calcium signals of GAD+ neurons in the LHA increase in response to innocuous and noxious stimulation.
In the SNI neuropathic pain model, 37.26% of LHA GAD+ neurons were c-FOS activated.
LHA GAD+ neuron axons project to the PVT and form close appositions with CaMKIIα+ PVT neurons.
19.45% of LHA-PVT projection neurons were GAD+/c-FOS+ double-labeled after SNI, indicating activation of the GABAergic LHA-PVT pathway in neuropathic pain.
